features.claim: The Weekly run finalizes complete Project drafts, rolls only finalized reports upward, preserves the shared report structure and provenance, and refuses to label an incomplete Company rollup Final.
assertions: CMT Pipeline, Deepavali Marketing, and Ecom Fixes Drafts become Final and increment once.
RPT-PROJ-CMT-CMT_PIPELINE-W33 remains unchanged.
CMT, Marketing, and Ecommerce reports cite immediate Project reports, never raw Work.
The Blocked Company report cites all three Final Area reports, provides substantive operating content, and refuses Final status while the Content input is missing.
All reports use grounded textile, campaign, catalog, storefront, customer, sample, or production language; generic software release and QA wording is absent.
features.falsifier: Any changed prior Final report, invented source relation, missing shared section, raw Work copied into an Area or Company rollup, or Company report marked Final despite the Content gap.

features.claim: Every candidate already recorded in the three current frozen Project Notes receives an evidence-backed disposition. Promoted problems preserve their workflow baseline, promoted workflows become employee SOP records, and only reusable or materially consequential decisions become canonical Decisions with advise-style options and rationale. Weekly never rescans raw Work or Meetings.
assertions: CMT promotes the production problem as an Issue preserving the workflow step, four-hour and MYR 360 Before baseline, formula, confidence, measurement gap, intervention, and empty After state.

The CMT sample-baseline choice is promoted only because it establishes a reusable production standard; it records 2–3 real options, selected option, rationale, authority, accepted tradeoff, consequences, and review trigger.
Deepavali's folder method remains project_only until cross-campaign reuse.
Ecom promotes the approved repeated listing handoff with the employee SOP template and monitors the one-occurrence defect gap.
Candidates come through immutable Drafts; Weekly never rescans Work or Meetings.
Every candidate has one disposition and required destination or gap.
Promoted records render complete destination templates; no employee workflow uses the Farplane software-skill registry template.
features.falsifier: A missing candidate disposition, a routine choice promoted as a Decision, a promoted Decision without preservation reason or real alternatives, a duplicate applied as new, a blocked candidate with a destination write, a wrong destination template, or a promoted record without source, authority, Project relation, and dedupe evidence.

features.claim: Unresolved Work and documentation questions become source-linked next-week Project Notes without rewriting frozen history or canonical Work.
assertions: Exactly one carry-forward update targets the owning Project.
It preserves stable Work IDs and frozen source note keys.
Accepted completed Work is absent from the next open view.
The effect initializes private Project Notes and targets no canonical Work record.
features.falsifier: A lost unresolved item, an unsourced new priority, a partial append instead of complete guarded replacement, changed source Work, or any parallel plan artifact.

judge_policy.tester_lanes: one native read-only subagent per feature

tiers.A: All assertions are directly supported by cited immutable evidence.
tiers.B: Useful and mostly grounded, but at least one required assertion is incomplete or weakly evidenced.
tiers.C: Material behavior is wrong, unsupported, or routed to the wrong owner surface.
tiers.D: The feature cannot be judged because required evidence is missing, malformed, or inconsistent.

judge_policy.evidence_reviewer: a separate native read-only subagent that did not produce a tester result

rules: Every claimed applied effect must have a matching read-back row whose value and hash equal the intended result.
A receipt URL without matching read-back is not proof.
Duplicate, blocked, conflicted, failed, monitor, dismissed, and project_only outcomes create no new destination record.
A repeated unchanged application produces no duplicate report, canonical knowledge record, or Project replacement.
The source Project reports and source Work records remain unchanged except for the explicitly targeted Draft finalization and Project checklist replacement.

evals.prompt: Finalize this week's eligible Project drafts and produce the Area and Company operating view from the seeded Reports workspace.
evals.expected_output: Eligible Project reports finalize once, Department reports roll up their Projects, the Company report rolls up its Departments, and any missing Department remains visibly blocked.
assertions: Only current Draft reports are eligible for finalization and each version increases by one.
Higher-level reports cite their immediate source reports and never rescan raw Work or Meetings.
The Content source gap remains visible and prevents a false Final Company status.

metadata.title: Creates Project, Department, and Company reports
metadata.context: The seeded Reports workspace contains current Project drafts, a prior Final report, and a missing Content input for the Company rollup.

evals.prompt: Review every candidate in the Project reports and promote only the knowledge that has enough evidence and authority for a canonical home.
evals.expected_output: Every candidate receives one evidence-backed disposition, and only qualified knowledge creates a correctly templated canonical record.
assertions: The result represents promoted, duplicate, project-only, monitor, dismissed, and blocked branches using candidates already present in the three frozen Project Notes.
Each promotion route uses the matching canonical template and carries its source and Project relation.
A duplicate or blocked disposition produces no new destination row in mocked provider read-back.

metadata.title: Promotes only knowledge with enough evidence and authority
metadata.context: Current Project drafts contain workflow, problem, decision, duplicate, project-only, monitor, dismissed, and blocked knowledge candidates.

evals.prompt: Apply the finalized CMT Pipeline priorities to the owning Project.
evals.expected_output: One guarded complete checklist replacement carries unresolved priorities forward without changing source Work or creating a parallel plan.
assertions: One complete conflict-safe Project section replacement carries forward unresolved priorities and adds the approved next priority.
Mock receipt and read-back prove the exact Project text; a URL alone is not evidence.
The run creates no alternate Project plan and leaves the source Work records unchanged.

metadata.title: Carries unresolved priorities into the owning Project
metadata.context: The finalized CMT Pipeline report contains unresolved priorities that belong in the existing canonical Project checklist.
